name: selkea
description: Clearer terminal transcript: your messages and Claude's answers in named frames, notes between steps as quiet lines, bold text in colour and a rule with the duration at the end of every turn.

boxes.title: Which Claude text to frame
boxes.description: vastaukset frames only multi-line answers; kaikki frames everything Claude writes

language.title: Frame labels
language.description: fi: Sinä / Claude, en: You / Claude

bold.title: Colour of bold text
bold.description: turkoosi (cyan), vihreä (green) or violetti (magenta) colours bold text in the terminal's own shade; pois leaves it as plain bold
